title: Boring
subtitle: 「無聊」，究竟是因為沒有趣味、太長、太重複、太平凡，還是無聊到令人想睡？
description: 「無聊」，究竟是因為沒有趣味、太長、太重複、太平凡，還是無聊到令人想睡？

words.note: 最直接、最常見的近義詞之一。可形容談話、課堂、工作、書本、電影等缺乏趣味或刺激。
words.example: The lecture was informative but rather dull.
words.exampleZh: 這堂講座內容有資訊性，但相當沉悶。

exercises.original: The lecture covered useful material, but it was boring to listen to.
exercises.zh: 講座內容有用，但聽起來很沉悶。
exercises.upgrade: The lecture covered useful material, but it was dull to listen to.

options.explanation: 缺乏趣味和活力，正好描述有內容但講得沉悶的講座。
也可表示乏味，但通常更突出冗長或費力；此句只說聽起來無趣。
也可能合理，但 dry 更常指內容／講法過於學術或缺乏生動感。
重複的；句子沒有提供重複線索。

exercises.original: The conversation became boring after they started discussing office paperwork.
exercises.zh: 他們開始談辦公室文件後，對話變得乏味。
exercises.upgrade: The conversation became dull after they started discussing office paperwork.

options.explanation: dull conversation 是很自然的搭配，表示缺乏趣味。
可表示單調，但更需要『缺乏變化』線索。
通常形容一天、旅程等沒有事件，不適合 conversation。
技術性的；技術內容不一定無聊。

exercises.original: I found the film visually impressive but boring overall.
exercises.zh: 我覺得這部電影視覺上令人印象深刻，但整體很無聊。
exercises.upgrade: I found the film visually impressive but dull overall.

options.explanation: 可預測的；可能令人無聊，但不是 boring 的直接同義詞。
節奏慢；可能是原因，但不等於無聊。
可形容作品缺乏活力，但比 dull 更偏效果／表演。

words.meaning: 冗長乏味的；令人厭煩的
words.note: 強調某件事因為太長、太重複或太費時間而令人厭煩。常用於工作、程序、細節、任務。
words.example: Entering the data by hand was a tedious process.
words.exampleZh: 手動輸入數據是一個冗長乏味的過程。

exercises.original: Checking every entry manually was boring because it took hours.
exercises.zh: 逐項手動檢查很乏味，因為要花數小時。
exercises.upgrade: Checking every entry manually was tedious because it took hours.

options.explanation: 耗時、逐項進行的工作令人厭煩，完全符合 tedious 的典型語義。
也可表示無聊，但沒有充分表達『長時間、費工』。
可能重複，但句子最明顯線索是 took hours。
複雜的；複雜不一定無聊。
短暫的；和 took hours 相反。

exercises.original: The application process was long, detailed, and boring.
exercises.zh: 申請程序冗長、細節多而令人厭煩。
exercises.upgrade: The application process was long, detailed, and tedious.

options.explanation: long + detailed 是典型線索，表示程序冗長乏味。
平凡日常；沒有突出長而繁瑣。
單調可相關，但程序的繁瑣耗時更適合 tedious。
簡單的；和 detailed / long 不符。

exercises.original: Writing the same reference number on hundreds of forms was boring work.
exercises.zh: 在數百份表格上寫同一個參考編號是很乏味的工作。
exercises.upgrade: Writing the same reference number on hundreds of forms was tedious work.

options.explanation: 確實重複，但題目要找最接近 boring 且突出大量手工工作的詞。
數百份表格、反覆手寫，既長又費力，最貼切。
例行的；不必然令人厭煩。

words.note: 強調缺乏變化，內容或聲音反覆相同，所以令人無聊。
words.example: The job became monotonous after a few months.
words.exampleZh: 幾個月後，這份工作變得單調乏味。

exercises.original: The machine made the same boring sound all day.
exercises.zh: 機器整天發出同一種單調聲音。
exercises.upgrade: The machine made the same monotonous sound all day.

options.explanation: same sound all day 直接表示缺乏變化，最精準。
通常形容工作／過程，而非聲音本身。
可形容聲音低沉或無趣，但 lack of variation 更適合 monotonous。
不規則；與 same 相反。

exercises.original: The job became boring because every day followed exactly the same routine.
exercises.zh: 這份工作變得單調，因為每天都完全一樣。
exercises.upgrade: The job became monotonous because every day followed exactly the same routine.

options.explanation: 日常平凡，可接近，但 exactly the same routine 更直接支持 monotonous。
可令人厭煩，但未必表示每天一樣。
沒有事件；不是核心『重複相同』。

exercises.original: His boring speaking style never changed in tone or pace.
exercises.zh: 他的說話方式語調和速度從不變化，十分單調。
exercises.upgrade: His monotonous speaking style never changed in tone or pace.

options.explanation: 可表示枯燥，但不特別指聲調不變。
tone or pace never changed 是典型 monotonous 線索。
可能令人想睡，但題目首先描述的是無變化。

words.note: 非常直接、語氣較弱的近義詞。表示某事沒有引起興趣，但不一定令人強烈厭煩。
words.example: I found the first half of the film uninteresting.
words.exampleZh: 我覺得電影上半部不太有趣。

exercises.original: The topic seemed boring to most of the students.
exercises.zh: 大部分學生都覺得這個題目不太有趣。
exercises.upgrade: The topic seemed uninteresting to most of the students.

options.explanation: 最直接、語氣較弱地表示沒有引起興趣。

exercises.original: I thought the first chapter was boring, but the book improved later.
exercises.zh: 我覺得第一章無趣，但後來好看了。
exercises.upgrade: I thought the first chapter was uninteresting, but the book improved later.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 uninteresting 更直接、較中性地表達沒有興趣。
和 improved later 對比自然，表示前段未能吸引人。
寫得差；原句沒有這個判斷。

exercises.original: The museum display was accurate but boring.
exercises.zh: 博物館展覽準確，但不太吸引人。
exercises.upgrade: The museum display was accurate but uninteresting.

options.explanation: 準確但缺乏吸引力，這個較弱近義詞最自然。
不正確；與 accurate 相反。
可表示平凡，但不如 uninteresting 直接。

words.note: 表示某事重複、麻煩或令人疲憊，因而變得無聊甚至惱人。比 boring 多一點『令人煩厭』的意味。
words.example: The repeated delays became increasingly tiresome.
words.exampleZh: 一次又一次的延誤愈來愈令人厭煩。

exercises.original: His repeated complaints became boring and annoying.
exercises.zh: 他反覆抱怨，變得令人厭煩。
exercises.upgrade: His repeated complaints became tiresome.

options.explanation: repeated + annoying 正是 tiresome 的典型語義。
可表示乏味，但較少突出惱人。
可預測的；只是部分原因。

exercises.original: The constant interruptions were boring after a while.
exercises.zh: 不斷被打斷，過了一會便令人厭煩。
exercises.upgrade: The constant interruptions became tiresome after a while.

options.explanation: constant interruptions 令人煩厭，最自然。
無事發生，和 interruptions 相反。

exercises.original: The same argument is becoming boring to hear again and again.
exercises.zh: 同一個論點一再重複，愈來愈令人厭煩。
exercises.upgrade: The same argument is becoming tiresome to hear again and again.

options.explanation: 描述重複本身，但題目要形容聽者感到厭煩。
again and again 造成煩厭，最貼切。

words.meaning: 令人疲乏的；令人厭倦的
words.note: 比 tiresome 稍正式、稍文學化，強調長時間持續後使人精神疲乏、厭倦。
words.example: The long and wearisome debate lasted all afternoon.
words.exampleZh: 這場漫長而令人疲乏的辯論持續了整個下午。

exercises.original: The debate was long, repetitive, and boring.
exercises.zh: 辯論漫長、重複而令人疲乏。
exercises.upgrade: The debate was long, repetitive, and wearisome.

options.explanation: long + repetitive 強調長時間造成精神疲乏，最精準。
也很接近，但 wearisome 更突出疲乏感。

exercises.original: The journey became boring and exhausting after many hours.
exercises.zh: 多小時後，旅程變得令人疲乏又厭倦。
exercises.upgrade: The journey became wearisome after many hours.

options.explanation: many hours + exhausting 支持長時間造成的精神／身體厭倦。
平凡日常，不適合旅程疲勞。

exercises.original: The endless administrative routine was boring and draining.
exercises.zh: 無休止的行政例行工作既乏味又消耗精神。
exercises.upgrade: The endless administrative routine was wearisome and draining.

options.explanation: 可形容日常單調，但 endless + draining 更支持 wearisome。
表示長時間重複後令人疲乏，最合適。

words.note: 本身只表示重複，但在工作、練習、內容等語境中，經常暗示因為反覆相同而無聊。
words.example: The assembly-line work was highly repetitive.
words.exampleZh: 生產線工作非常重複乏味。

exercises.original: The job was boring because I had to perform the same action every minute.
exercises.zh: 這份工作很乏味，因為我每分鐘都要做同一個動作。
exercises.upgrade: The job was repetitive because I had to perform the same action every minute.

options.explanation: 也可表示單調，但 same action every minute 更直接指重複性。
最精確地指出工作反覆做同一動作。

exercises.original: The exercises became boring because each one used the same pattern.
exercises.zh: 每道練習都用相同模式，因此變得重複乏味。
exercises.upgrade: The exercises became repetitive because each one used the same pattern.

options.explanation: 可能令人厭煩，但 same pattern 明確支持 repetitive。
相同模式反覆出現，最貼切。
枯燥，但未指出重複原因。

exercises.original: The soundtrack was boring because the same melody kept returning.
exercises.zh: 配樂因同一旋律不斷重現而顯得重複乏味。
exercises.upgrade: The soundtrack was repetitive because the same melody kept returning.

options.explanation: 也合理，但 repetitive 更直接對應 same melody kept returning。
反覆同一旋律，精確描述重複性。

words.meaning: 平淡乏味的；日常單調的
words.note: 常形容生活、工作、日常活動缺乏刺激或新鮮感。比 boring 更帶『平凡、日復一日』的味道。
words.example: He wanted to escape his humdrum routine.
words.exampleZh: 他想擺脫平淡乏味的日常生活。

exercises.original: He was tired of his boring daily routine.
exercises.zh: 他厭倦了平淡乏味的日常生活。
exercises.upgrade: He was tired of his humdrum daily routine.

options.explanation: daily routine + 缺乏刺激，是 humdrum 的典型語境。
可乏味，但不特別帶日常平凡感。

exercises.original: She wanted a more exciting life than the boring existence she had known.
exercises.zh: 她想過比以往平淡生活更刺激的人生。
exercises.upgrade: She wanted a more exciting life than the humdrum existence she had known.

options.explanation: 也接近，但 humdrum existence 更自然地帶平淡日復一日感。
與 more exciting life 形成直接對比，最貼切。
偏沒有事件發生，不完全等於整體生活乏味。

exercises.original: The office job seemed safe but boring and ordinary.
exercises.zh: 這份辦公室工作安全，但平凡乏味。
exercises.upgrade: The office job seemed safe but humdrum and ordinary.

options.explanation: ordinary 已提供平凡日常線索，humdrum 最自然。
太強且常形容使人想睡的講話／聲音。
難預測；和 humdrum 相反。

words.meaning: 平凡乏味的；日常瑣碎的
words.note: 表示普通、日常、缺乏特別之處。它不一定等於無聊，但在許多語境中可表示『因太平凡而乏味』。
words.example: She was tired of the mundane tasks of office administration.
words.exampleZh: 她厭倦了辦公室行政中平凡乏味的工作。

exercises.original: She was bored by the ordinary tasks of office administration.
exercises.zh: 她厭倦了辦公室行政中平凡瑣碎的工作。
exercises.upgrade: She was bored by the mundane tasks of office administration.

options.explanation: ordinary tasks 是直接線索，表示平凡日常而欠刺激。
也可能乏味，但 mundane 更突出普通瑣碎。

exercises.original: The film focuses on the boring details of everyday life.
exercises.zh: 電影聚焦日常生活中平凡瑣碎的細節。
exercises.upgrade: The film focuses on the mundane details of everyday life.

options.explanation: everyday life + details 是典型搭配。
可沉悶，但帶陰鬱感，原句未提供。
技術性的；不是日常瑣碎。

exercises.original: He wanted to escape the boring chores that filled his weekends.
exercises.zh: 他想擺脫週末那些平凡乏味的雜務。
exercises.upgrade: He wanted to escape the mundane chores that filled his weekends.

options.explanation: 可能重複，但 chores + ordinary daily nature 更適合 mundane。
家務／雜務的普通日常性正是 mundane。

words.meaning: 沉悶乏味的；令人鬱悶的
words.note: 除了無聊，還常帶陰沉、缺乏活力、令人情緒低落的意味。可形容天氣、地方、工作、生活、活動。
words.example: It was a dreary meeting with little new to discuss.
words.exampleZh: 這是一場沉悶的會議，幾乎沒有新內容可談。

exercises.original: The meeting was boring and gloomy, with little new to discuss.
exercises.zh: 會議沉悶又令人鬱悶，幾乎沒有新內容。
exercises.upgrade: The meeting was dreary, with little new to discuss.

options.explanation: 既無聊又帶低沉陰鬱感，和 gloomy 線索完全吻合。
只表示沉悶，未充分表達 gloom。

exercises.original: It was a boring grey afternoon with nothing to do.
exercises.zh: 那是一個灰暗沉悶、無事可做的下午。
exercises.upgrade: It was a dreary grey afternoon with nothing to do.

options.explanation: 沒有事情發生，可接近，但 grey 的情緒色彩更支持 dreary。
grey + nothing to do 帶沉悶、陰鬱感，最自然。
日常平凡，不特別指灰暗氣氛。
忙碌；和 nothing to do 相反。

exercises.original: The town looked boring and lifeless in the rain.
exercises.zh: 雨中的小鎮看起來沉悶而沒有生氣。
exercises.upgrade: The town looked dreary and lifeless in the rain.

options.explanation: 可表示沉悶，但 rain + lifeless 更有 dreary 的陰沉感。
環境陰沉、無生氣，典型用法。
通常形容缺乏變化，不適合 town looked。

words.note: 當 boring 用來形容課題、文章、講解或學術內容缺乏生動感時，dry 很自然。
words.example: The textbook is useful, but some chapters are very dry.
words.exampleZh: 這本教科書很有用，但有些章節非常枯燥。

exercises.original: The textbook is useful, but some chapters are boring and overly factual.
exercises.zh: 這本教科書有用，但有些章節過於事實化而枯燥。
exercises.upgrade: The textbook is useful, but some chapters are dry and overly factual.

options.explanation: 過度事實化、缺乏生動感，是 dry 的典型語義。
可無聊，但未突出 factual style。
不正確；和 useful 不符。
技術性不一定等於枯燥。

exercises.original: His presentation was accurate but boring because it contained only statistics.
exercises.zh: 他的簡報準確，但只有統計數字，顯得很枯燥。
exercises.upgrade: His presentation was accurate but dry because it contained only statistics.

options.explanation: 只有統計數字、缺乏生動呈現，最符合 dry。
可能語調單調，但句子說的是內容。
不正確；與 accurate 相反。

exercises.original: The article explains an important subject in a rather boring academic style.
exercises.zh: 文章以相當枯燥的學術風格解釋重要議題。
exercises.upgrade: The article explains an important subject in a rather dry academic style.

options.explanation: dry academic style 是自然搭配，表示缺乏生動感。
平凡日常，不適合 academic style。

words.meaning: 平淡無事的；沒有甚麼事情發生的
words.note: 當 boring 是因為沒有事件、變化或刺激發生時，uneventful 很貼切。它本身較客觀，不一定帶強烈負面情緒。
words.example: The journey was long but uneventful.
words.exampleZh: 旅程很長，但一路平淡無事。

exercises.original: The journey was boring because nothing unusual happened.
exercises.zh: 旅程很平淡，因為沒有任何特別事情發生。
exercises.upgrade: The journey was uneventful because nothing unusual happened.

options.explanation: nothing unusual happened 是直接定義線索。
可能單調，但未強調重複，而是沒有事件。

exercises.original: It was a boring evening with no calls, visitors, or surprises.
exercises.zh: 那是一個平淡無事的晚上，沒有電話、訪客或驚喜。
exercises.upgrade: It was an uneventful evening with no calls, visitors, or surprises.

options.explanation: 可能沉悶，但未有陰鬱線索。
no calls, visitors, or surprises 明確表示沒有事件。
偏日常反覆，不是單晚沒有事情。
社交的；與 no visitors 不符。

exercises.original: The flight was boring but safe, with nothing noteworthy happening.
exercises.zh: 航班平淡但安全，沒有值得注意的事情發生。
exercises.upgrade: The flight was uneventful but safe, with nothing noteworthy happening.

options.explanation: 在交通／新聞語境中，表示沒有事故或值得注意事件，非常自然。
可指長而無聊，但 safe + nothing noteworthy 更支持 uneventful。

words.meaning: 無聊到令人麻木的；極度乏味的
words.note: 比 boring 強很多，常形容極端重複、機械化、需要長時間集中卻毫無刺激的工作或程序。
words.example: Copying thousands of numbers by hand was mind-numbing.
words.exampleZh: 手動抄寫數千個數字無聊得令人麻木。

exercises.original: Copying thousands of numbers by hand was extremely boring.
exercises.zh: 手動抄寫數千個數字無聊得令人麻木。
exercises.upgrade: Copying thousands of numbers by hand was mind-numbing.

options.explanation: 極端重複、機械化又耗時，正是這個強烈詞的典型用法。
也合適，但強度不及 extremely boring + thousands。

exercises.original: The job involved eight hours of boring data entry every day.
exercises.zh: 工作每天包括八小時極度乏味的數據輸入。
exercises.upgrade: The job involved eight hours of mind-numbing data entry every day.

options.explanation: 描述重複性，但 eight hours every day + boring 支持更強烈的 mind-numbing。
長時間機械式 data entry，最自然。

exercises.original: The training video was so boring that several people struggled to stay focused.
exercises.zh: 培訓影片無聊得令幾個人難以集中精神。
exercises.upgrade: The training video was so mind-numbing that several people struggled to stay focused.

options.explanation: 也可令人想睡，但句子說的是 mentally deadening / focus，而非睡意。
so boring + struggled to stay focused 顯示極端精神麻木感。

words.meaning: 催眠般乏味的；令人昏昏欲睡的
words.note: 較高階、較幽默或書面的詞。原意是令人想睡；形容講座、演說、聲音等時，可表示無聊得像催眠一樣。
words.example: The speaker's slow, soporific delivery made it hard to stay awake.
words.exampleZh: 講者緩慢而催眠般乏味的講法令人難以保持清醒。

exercises.original: The speaker's slow, boring delivery made it hard to stay awake.
exercises.zh: 講者緩慢而乏味的講法令人難以保持清醒。
exercises.upgrade: The speaker's slow, soporific delivery made it hard to stay awake.

options.explanation: 語調可能單調，但 hard to stay awake 直接支持 soporific。
原意就是令人昏昏欲睡；slow delivery + stay awake 是明確線索。

exercises.original: The lecture was boring enough to make half the audience sleepy.
exercises.zh: 講座乏味得令一半觀眾昏昏欲睡。
exercises.upgrade: The lecture was soporific enough to make half the audience sleepy.

options.explanation: 可無聊，但 sleepy 是更直接的 soporific 線索。
表示催眠般令人想睡，最精準。

exercises.original: His calm voice became boring in a way that almost put me to sleep.
exercises.zh: 他平靜的聲音乏味得幾乎令我睡着。
exercises.upgrade: His calm voice became soporific in a way that almost put me to sleep.

options.explanation: 可能單調，但 almost put me to sleep 更直接對應 soporific。
舒緩；可能令人放鬆，但不一定有 boring 的負面意思。
既可形容聲音，又明確表示令人想睡。

falseSynonyms.zh: 一件事可以很難但非常有趣，也可以很容易但非常無聊。
falseSynonyms.point: The puzzle was difficult but fascinating.

falseSynonyms.zh: 電影、演講或故事可以 slow-paced，但仍然很有吸引力。 slow 可能是 boring 的原因，但不是同義詞。
repetitive 表示相同內容反覆出現。 它常令人 boring，但一件事可以 repetitive 而仍然有用或令人享受。
mundane 強調普通、日常、瑣碎。 有些 mundane activities 可能令人放鬆，不一定 boring。
dry 常形容： 表示資訊可能有用，但呈現不生動。
uneventful 可以是中性甚至正面： 在安全語境中，這往往是好事。
tiresome 通常比 boring 多一層「令人煩厭／厭倦」的意味。
soporific 很強，而且帶「令人想睡」的特定效果。 不能把所有 boring things 都叫 soporific。
